causes.every_occurrence_of_a_listed_name_is_rep: The detector lists identifier strings and the matcher marks every occurrence, so a surname that is also a common word or a disease name (Short, White, Page, Bell, Cushing, Wilson) is replaced in 'Short of breath' and 'Wilson disease' as well as where it is the patient's name. 41 of the 108.
causes.relative_and_year_only_dates: 'last Tuesday', 'tomorrow' and '2019' were listed as dates; the dataset's rules do not label them. 67 of the 108. Replacing them is the cautious direction but can change what the note says.
